correctness.rationale: The lifted Rule 140 local equivalence is a 27-case identity. Strict coordinatewise decrease gives certain fixation by 2n. The 2015 preimage density identity and verified four-state transfer certificate yield the exact one-site expected decrement; the causal cone/union bound gives the upper tail. An explicit protected two-run motif of length t+4 has exact lifetime t, and an overlap-covariance second moment yields the lower tail; both imply O_P(1) centered fluctuations and the stated bounded expectation correction by summing tails. All small-window and cyclic-state computations were replayed from the packaged script. Dependence on the cited published all-depth density-preimage theorem and the absence of external peer verification are disclosed.

value.rationale: The earlier observed polynomial-exponential one-site decay is of genuine dynamical interest, but it leaves open the whole-system relaxation clock. The logarithmic-logarithmic correction is a quantitative global invariant arising from the interaction of two descending symbol runs. The result determines both typical scale and mean to bounded error on an arbitrary-length natural cellular automaton, providing a nontrivial bridge between a spectral degeneracy and rare-pattern extremes, rather than rederiving only the published density.
